name: Meryl Silverburgh — original MGS1
incarnation: Metal Gear Solid (1998), PlayStation1; original rebel outfit

review.reviewer: pass3_meryl_native; original primary/supplementary source files and every final sheet physically viewed + pass3_sprite_integrator — all six native atlases physically viewed, Konami primary body/hair and original PS1 captures inspected
notes: Original MGS1 character and weapon identity only: no TwinSnakes or MGS4 costume mix, no unsupported MGS3 knife.

Near tattoo arm changes with independent camera view: RIGHT-facing near anatomicalLEFT upperarm has original FOXHOUND marking; LEFT-facing near anatomicalRIGHT upperarm is plain. Tattoo occlusion on far side is preserved instead of flipping PNG.
RIGHT holster remains same anatomicalleg through opposite walk contacts; grenade throwing arm corrected to anatomicalRIGHT with LEFT tattoo balancing arm.

Original unsuppressed heavy angular DesertEagle pistol in right-hand trigger/left-hand support phases; holster empty when pistol drawn. No extra rendered projectile/explosion beyond small hand-held grenade.
Every native PNG byte unchanged; native alpha component bounds measured read-only;12 major connected body components per final and0 alpha48 opaque externaledge pixels.
Generation correction may alter some subpixel pose/inkshape details; sole tattoo marking is small source-derived FOXHOUND motif, not exact readable original tattoo at native game pixels.
limits: Aiming, punches, throws, sweep, grenades, reload and KO are original2D versus adaptations; not native PS1 animation extraction or pixel-certified source clones.
Primary official Konami body artwork is painterly: colors reconciled with original emulated game captures, which are filtered/non-native aspect; not absolute PS1 pixel certification.
B-left last-column bootmargin narrow although complete and0 opaqueedge; final runtime crop/scale/pose validation belongs sequential integration owner.
Some native generator output includes very-low-alpha RGB fringes; no recoloring/alpha repair/image editing outside imagegen performed.
Tiny firearm and tattoo engravings are not certified at subpixel detail; pose handgrips are closest reviewed reference adaptation.

Standing source pixel scale is manually observed per independent PNG; low/crouch/KO preserve that scale instead of stretching to full standing height. Local display height is a versus adaptation, not a source-frame pixel certification.
Grenade action belongs to the authored CQC versus adaptation stated in the preserved original profile. Meryl scripted original PS1 grenade use is not claimed.

Very close source rows require a Canvas contour restricted to pixels closest to the selected body component; no neighboring boot fringe should be drawn over a gun pose head. The alpha PNG itself remains unchanged.
